profile.name: Keysight N9020B MXA信号分析仪
profile.description: 这是一台台式射频/微波信号分析仪，可在频谱分析模式下测量信号的频率分布、功率电平和峰值位置。它常用于实验室中的射频链路调试、信号源与放大器表征、杂散与谐波观察，以及频谱扫描和标记测量。
profile.description_en: This is a benchtop RF/microwave signal analyzer used in spectrum analysis mode to measure signal frequency distribution, power level, and peak locations. It is commonly used in laboratories for RF chain debugging, source and amplifier characterization, spurious and harmonic observation, spectrum sweeps, and marker-based measurements.
